messages:
leo-k: Hi team — planning to move from CA to WA on 2026-06-01. Aside from Workday address, anything else I need to do?

people-ops: Congrats Leo! Please submit the Location Change form and attach proof of address. That kicks off payroll and benefits checks.

leo-k: Will WFH stipend continue? Any proration for the month I move?

payroll-bot: @leo-k payroll will pro-rate the monthly WFH stipend based on your effective date after people-ops confirms. Expect change on next pay run.

tax-ops: WA has no state income tax, but sales/use and local taxes can differ. Also flag: if you work >120 days in another state we may need to review nexus. Finance will be notified.

leo-k: Form submitted (link: https://hr.internal/forms/location-change/1769912345). Attached lease.

people-ops: Received. Well: update HRIS, notify payroll for withholding/stipend, and confirm benefits carrier eligibility. If anything changes on premiums we'll give notice before payroll runs.

leo-k: Thanks! Do I need to update hardware shipping address for the one-time setup stipend?

people-ops: Yes, include shipping address on the form. One-time stipend processed after verification.

leo-k: Awesome, appreciate the help.
